label: Night Lockout
info:
Forces the cat flap locked overnight via the SurePetcare API, as a backup for when the app's own curfew doesn't reliably keep a cat in.

## Setup
1. Configure the surepetcare-config node with your credentials
2. Open 'Overnight Lock' and set the Device ID (use Discover, or the numeric ID from GET /device)
3. Adjust the two inject nodes' cron times to your curfew window (defaults: lock at 20:00, unlock at 07:00)
4. Deploy - the flow fires automatically at those times, or click either inject button to test

## Lock state choice
Defaults to lockState 3 (locked both ways), matching what you'd set manually on the flap - no exit, no entry, during curfew hours.

If you'd rather still let a cat back in during curfew (in case it's already out when the lock engages), change the 'Lock' inject node's payload from {"lockState": 3} to {"lockState": 1} for locked-in / entry-only.

## Notes
- This runs independently of the app's built-in curfew, so it still applies even if that feature misbehaves
- Errors (network issues, auth failures) are caught and shown in the 'Error' debug tab rather than crashing the flow
